item.title: Artemis 0.9.5
item.description:
A fix release. It needs macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

Fixed in 0.9.5

  • Artemis could crash on launch when there was no page to restore, for example on a fresh install. Fixed.

New

  • AppleScript and Shortcuts can list and control Artemis's windows, spaces and tabs. Running JavaScript inside pages from a script stays off unless you turn it on in Settings › Privacy.

item.title: Artemis 0.9.4
item.description:
A quick follow-up to 0.9.3. It needs macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

Fixed in 0.9.4

  • The download animation now actually shows: the file flies from where you clicked into the Library button.
  • With the sidebar hidden, downloads appear in a small pill at the window's bottom-left, and the file flies there instead.

item.title: Artemis 0.9.3
item.description:
The fourth alpha of Artemis for macOS. It needs macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

New in 0.9.3

  • Downloads you can see. A new download flies from where you clicked into the Library button, a ring around it fills as it arrives, and a pill above the sidebar footer shows the file, its progress and a tick when it's done. Click it to open the file (⌘-click shows it in Finder). The Dock icon counts running downloads.
  • Check for Updates is in the command bar (⌘T, type "update"), as well as the Artemis menu.
  • The address bar stays put properly when the sidebar opens or closes under it.

If you're on 0.9.2, this arrives on its own: look for Relaunch to Update at the bottom of the sidebar.

item.title: Artemis 0.9.2
item.description:
The third alpha of Artemis for macOS. It needs macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

New in 0.9.2

  • Automatic updates. From this version on, Artemis updates itself: new versions download quietly, then a Relaunch to Update button appears in the sidebar. Choose Release or Beta in Settings › General › Updates.
  • Send Feedback (Help menu) now posts your message as a public issue here, so you can follow it. Your email, screenshot and page address always stay private, and Keep this private posts nothing public.

If you're on 0.9.1, download this one by hand once; after that, updates arrive on their own.

Opening it the first time: this build isn't notarised by Apple yet, so macOS stops it the first time. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway next to Artemis, then click Open. You only do this once.
